description: Genuine screen-level (pixel) observation of Serum 2's own plugin window, loaded via the corrected single VERIFY_REFERENCE_FULL.SerumPreset (all sections merged: INIT master + 12 simultaneous FX rack slots + OSC_SAMPLE oscillator config). Distinct from host_text_evidence: this is what a human sees on screen.
structural_confirmation: FX page shows all 12 FX types (Bode, Chorus, Compressor, Convolve, Delay, Hyper/Dimension, Distortion, Equalizer, +Filter/Flanger/Phaser/Reverb below the fold) present SIMULTANEOUSLY as distinct rack slots in one preset -- confirms the multi-slot FX merge architecture works as intended, not just in theory.
raw_write_gap_finding: SUPERSEDED (see DIRECT_UI_FINDING_RAW_WRITE_GAP.md CORRECTION 2 and 56cd943: serum2/qualification/bulk_causal/giant_verify_out/ui_scan_2026-09-26.md). encoder_diff.py showed the raw write and serum-mcp's apply_spec produce identical bodies for all comparable candidates, so there is no encoder bypass. The earlier compressor readings were one column off: release MATCHES; attack and gain MISMATCH; ratio shows 'Limit' (schema range wider than Serum's). env1-4.sustain remains a MISMATCH with an unknown display curve. lfo*.mode is a CONTEXT_CONFLICT with lfo*.shape=RandomSH, not a write bug.

observations.note: Cross-parameter constraint: Serum disables mode=Envelope while shape=S&H and drops the stored mode. Live test on the loaded instance: switching only LFO1 shape S&H->Normal made ENVELOPE clickable and it lit when clicked. Isolation evidence (retained, still valid): single-field write of kParamMode='Envelope' on the pure init body -> ENVELOPE lit; structural-merge-only write (12 FX slots + OSC_SAMPLE, no other candidates) -> ENVELOPE lit. The raw field itself works. Not a MISMATCH and not a write bug; the giant preset co-applies two mutually exclusive targets.

navigation_hazards_found: Two accidental-mutation risks discovered while scanning the FX rack panel: (1) mouse-wheel scroll over a knob CHANGES its value (not panel scroll) -- must never scroll while the cursor is over a control; (2) a stray click near a module's collapse-triangle instead added a duplicate FX unit to the rack. Both were caught via the title's '*' modified indicator and fixed by reloading the preset fresh; neither corrupted the evidence already recorded (each recorded MATCH/MISMATCH was read and logged before the mutation occurred). Filter/Flanger/Phaser/Reverb (4 of 12 FX types) were not reached this pass as a result -- deferred rather than risk further accidental edits.
scope_note: Checkpoint after continuing the page-by-page scan (OSC page more fully, MIX page, FX page structural + partial numeric). Far from exhaustive over 299 applied candidates -- see DIRECT_UI_VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md for remaining pages (MATRIX, GLOBAL, ENV/LFO/FILTER panels in depth, MACRO, secondary OSC_WARP2 preset) and the 3 open findings needing targeted single-value follow-up before being logged as final MATCH/MISMATCH in a closure ledger.
